diagnosticConventions.note: Diagnostic ground is local to this tool; shared lighting and camera functions are reused unchanged.

rootCompensation.method: Counter-translate IMPORT_ROOT in XY so the root bone remains at the first useful frame; align the lower foot to Z=0 and use a local 2.05 orthographic scale. Pose and skin data remain unchanged.
